body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Rollup of the `content-strategy-2026-10-01\` folder: the Q4 2026 content plan (published as the content plan artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/FY37pirrsS3QfubhSiowpg), the keyword pool it draws from, and the Oct 13 seasonal keyword research.

# Files
- `pipeliners-content-plan.html`: "Pipeliners Content Plan", eight new guides and a refresh cycle over 12 weeks, prepared Oct 1 from GSC (Jul 2 to Sep 28), saved Search Atlas research and a crawl of 106 live pages.
- `keyword_pool.csv`: 822 keyword rows (keyword, volume, KD, CPC, intent, source Search Atlas project). The reusable pool for new posts since Search Atlas lookups ran out Sep 26.
- `seasonal-keyword-research-2026-10-13.md`: see [Pipeliners - Seasonal Keyword Research 2026-10-13](lib:brain-pipeliners-seasonal-keyword-research-2026-10-13).

# Plan highlights
- **Where things stand:** 51 posts earned about zero clicks in 90 days; demand exists near services (cipp installation 1,217 impressions at position 63; "pipe relining vs replacement cost" at position 2). Repipe and manhole demand cannot be served.
- **Rules:** confirmed claims only, answer first, question headings, short FAQ, "last updated" date, house style, ad pages untouched, named author (Jake Shaker or Scott Vincent).
- **Clusters:** sewer and drain lining, sewer inspection, clogs/backups/hydro jetting, water lines/leaks/ePIPE. City pages are outside this plan.
- **New queue:** 1 relining cast iron pipe (590 / KD 7), 2 sewer camera inspection hub (8,100 / 18), 3 sewer cleanout (6,600 / 14), 4 Orangeburg pipe (260 / 22), 5 sewer scope before you buy (170 / 12), 6 hydro jetting a sewer line (1,000 / 15), 7 sewer lateral repair (880 / 28), 8 commercial drain cleaning (1,900 / 5, needs Scott). Cost topics left out (no prices).
- **Existing posts:** keep 36, update 4 (sewer smell year-round, cracked vs collapsed, slab leaks, pinhole leaks), re-angle 3 repipe posts, decide 5 (lining vs replacement pair, CIPP trio), hold 3 (myths pair, residential guide).
- **Calendar:** one new and one refresh a week from Oct 5 (Oct 5 cast iron, Oct 12 camera hub, Oct 19 cleanout, Oct 26 Orangeburg, Nov 2 sewer scope, Nov 9 hydro jetting...), weeks 9-12 for measuring.
